body:
This requirement is very ambiguous and seems to call for 2FA, which seems overly strong for level 1 applications.

See:
http://lists.owasp.org/pipermail/owasp-application-security-verification-standard/2015-October/000897.html
http://lists.owasp.org/pipermail/owasp-application-security-verification-standard/2016-January/000943.html

comments.body: I read that to mean uses good password hashing practices, such as bcrypt rather than unsalted sha1.
I have removed this item, as it IS too ambiguous, it is untestable, and it's more of a summary of all the other items for that level.
